libraries.name: Leaflet
libraries.advisory_status: OSV reports no vulnerability for leaflet 1.9.4 in the npm ecosystem. CVE-2025-69993 exists only as a GIT/CPE range whose newest event is last_affected, not fixed: no fixed release exists anywhere in the 1.x line, and 1.9.4 is still the newest non-prerelease on npm (only 2.0.0-alpha.1 is above it). Owner decision 2026-07-25: stay on 1.9.4, keeping the mitigation that MarkerVault popup call sites pass DOM nodes rather than raw user strings. Re-check for a fixed 1.x release at the next advisory review; 2.x is ESM-only with no global L and breaks this plugin set, so any migration is its own planned stage.

libraries.name: Swiper
libraries.advisory_status: PARTIALLY MITIGATED, gadget retained; NO FIXED UPSTREAM RELEASE IDENTIFIED as of 2026-07-26. Stage 13.1 upgraded 12.0.3 -> 12.2.0 for GHSA-hmx5-qpq5-p643 (CVE-2026-27212): extend() filtered __proto__/constructor/prototype through Array.prototype.indexOf, so polluting that method defeated the guard. 12.1.2 replaced indexOf with direct string comparisons and OSV reports 12.2.0 clean. THAT IS NOT THE WHOLE STORY: the direct comparisons are the callback to an equally overridable Array.prototype.filter, so replacing filter still defeats the guard. Executed against this exact bundle 2026-07-26 -- control blocked, filter-override bypass succeeded; reproduction tracked at tests/swiper_prototype_pollution_check.mjs. Reproduced independently against npm latest 14.0.6, so the deferred major would NOT resolve it. Upstream issue 8189 is open and current upstream master retains the pattern -- same posture as Leaflet 1.9.4 / CVE-2025-69993. Demonstrated prerequisites are prior tampering with Array.prototype.filter PLUS a crafted merge input; MarkerVault passes only fixed literal option objects and has no identified attacker-controlled path to that input, so application exploitability is UNCONFIRMED rather than proven absent. Re-run the tracked check at every Swiper upgrade. Owner decision 2026-07-25: the 14.0.6 major is deferred to a separately planned stage.
